Duration constant

You went all the way down both roads, and both of them are still holding you up.

While in a mixed frame, gain a +1 circumstance bonus to all saving throws.

cinderfall.incomplete: Live shipped bug, not a gap: this card's system.rules already carries an unconditional FlatModifier (+1 circumstance to all saving throws), but the printed text requires "while in a mixed frame." No "mixed-frame" RollOption or predicate exists anywhere in this corpus (MIXED-FRAME-GAP) to gate it correctly, so as shipped the bonus applies to every character regardless of frame. Not corrected in this pass -- the draft (.claude/scratch/feats-class-remade-draft.md, Open Question #1) frames the real fix as an owner decision between (a) leaving it unconditional and updating the card's own prose to match, or (b) building a mixed-frame detection mechanism first. This flag documents the bug; system.rules itself was left unchanged.
